name: Georgette Castner
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2022–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 1.

biography.text: Born in 1979 in Philadelphia. Castner earned a B.S. from The College of New Jersey (2002) and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School–Camden (2006). She clerked for New Jersey Appellate Division Judge Joseph F. Lisa, practiced in Cherry Hill from 2007 to 2022, and served as chief financial officer of Castner Consulting from 2018 to 2021. President Biden appointed her.
